title: A Price for Hurry
story: The workshop priced rush jobs at the ordinary rate, then wondered why the evenings vanished. Celia added a surcharge for work promised inside two days and showed it before anyone agreed. Two clients left. Those who stayed either waited or paid for the hurry. Income per hour rose, and the quiet weeks returned. A price that hides urgency teaches people that speed is free.

vocabulary.definition: Set the amount customers would pay
An extra charge added for a special demand
Work that has to be done very quickly
The need for something to be done at once

quiz.question: Which jobs attracted the new surcharge?
options: Work promised inside two days
Every ordinary job in the workshop
Only the clients who left
Quiet weeks with no hurry
quiz.explanation: Celia added a surcharge for work promised inside two days.
quiz.supportingSentence: Celia added a surcharge for work promised inside two days and showed it before anyone agreed.

quiz.question: What could the clients who stayed do?
options: Wait, or pay for the hurry
Leave without paying the ordinary rate
Hide the urgency and keep the old price
Set the workshop’s income themselves
quiz.correctAnswer: Wait, or pay for the hurry
quiz.explanation: Those who stayed either waited or paid for the hurry.
quiz.supportingSentence: Those who stayed either waited or paid for the hurry.

quiz.question: What does the choice given to remaining clients suggest?
options: Hurry was now optional and no longer bundled into the normal price
Everyone had to pay extra even if they waited
The ordinary rate had been abolished for all work
Quiet weeks were sold as a separate product
quiz.correctAnswer: Hurry was now optional and no longer bundled into the normal price
quiz.explanation: They could wait or pay for speed, so hurry had become a priced choice rather than part of the ordinary rate.
quiz.supportingSentence: Those who stayed either waited or paid for the hurry.

quiz.question: What is a surcharge in this passage?
options: An extra charge added for a special demand
A client who leaves the workshop
A quiet week with no orders
The ordinary rate for a normal job
quiz.correctAnswer: An extra charge added for a special demand
quiz.explanation: The surcharge is the extra amount for work promised inside two days.
quiz.supportingSentence: Celia added a surcharge for work promised inside two days and showed it before anyone agreed.

quiz.question: Why does the writer say Celia showed the surcharge before anyone agreed?
options: To show clients could accept or refuse the cost in advance
To prove the price was hidden until the work ended
To suggest two days was too long to wait
To argue that income per hour should fall
quiz.correctAnswer: To show clients could accept or refuse the cost in advance
quiz.explanation: Showing the charge before agreement means the cost was known before anyone said yes.
quiz.supportingSentence: Celia added a surcharge for work promised inside two days and showed it before anyone agreed.
